scope: explicit CPU PR-ABI backend/controller extension; not a production HLS ABI or commercial design qualification
csr_edge_id: u32 index into frozen PR-format Edge array, including distinct parallel arcs

native_edge_ref.encoding: one little-endian u32 (catalog_pip_id << 1) | reversed per CSR edge
native_edge_ref.constraints: native PIP catalog IDs below 2^31; unique key per directed CSR edge; reverse only for bidirectional PIPs
native_edge_ref.namespace: the immutable native PIP catalog frozen with this graph, not a universal PIP ID; subset catalogs can renumber the full-device IDs
native_edge_ref.trust_boundary: packer validates native endpoint membership/direction; host checks length and uniqueness; native DB verifier resolves selected PIPs independently. Host alone cannot authenticate catalog provenance. Freeze all graph, sidecar and catalog SHA-256 values together.

api.EdgeBatchResult: KernelBatchResult plus edge_paths aligned one-to-one with candidates; one CSR edge per candidate branch child
api.RRProposal: explicit requires_edge_identity plus branch edge_path; legacy commit rejects edge-required proposals
api.WidePathfinderResult: task_edges aligned with all routed tasks (source-to-sink including shared prefix); tree_edges contains one selected edge per net/tree child
api.timing: EdgeTimingAnalyzer sees complete task edge paths; tree seed delay follows selected edges; host rejects the legacy node-only external timing command in edge mode

non_native_output: native_pip_key is empty; CSR edge identity remains explicit

route_hash_schema.name: task_nodes_and_csr_edges_v1
route_hash_schema.encoding: existing byte-wise FNV-style hash_word(u64), initial 1469598103934665603 and multiplier 1099511628211; per task in input order: task ID, routed flag, node count, nodes, edge count, edges
route_hash_schema.precondition: identical frozen graph/sidecar/catalog hashes and configuration; not comparable with legacy task_nodes_v1 hashes

transaction_path_hash: same hash_word seed; attachment, candidate child nodes, selected branch edge IDs; legacy mode hashes remain unchanged
intra_node_slr_transition: no extra edge, node, hop, delay or occupancy entry
validation: selected edge must belong to parent CSR slice and terminate at child; task prefixes must agree with the selected net tree; stale resource reads checked before validation/replay; rejected current edge traces do not mutate authority
remaining: complete DCP route writeback and native QoR
